nodes.label: Backend layered structure (domain/ports/workflow/adapters/bootstrap)
nodes.rationale: domain.py depends on nothing external (no FastAPI/SDK/DB); ports.py describes required external capabilities without imposing a technology; bootstrap.py is the sole composition root.

nodes.label: Garde-fous (frontend removed, no auth in UI)
nodes.rationale: The UI is never an authorization boundary; every external mutation passes through ApprovalWorkflow then ApprovedMutationRunner after approval; a new generic utils/services/common folder is only created if its owner and contract are explicit.
